q: Which Danish author received the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1944?
appeared: It appeared in the June 2020 exam.

da.q: Hvilken dansk forfatter fik i 1944 Nobelprisen i litteratur?

learn.text: Johannes V. Jensen wrote Kongens Fald in 1901 and received the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1944.

q: Who wrote the novel Lykke-Per around the year 1900?
appeared: It appeared in the June 2020 and May 2023 exams.

da.q: Hvem skrev omkring år 1900 romanen Lykke-Per?

learn.text: Henrik Pontoppidan wrote Lykke-Per, 1898 to 1904, and received the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1917.

q: Who is known for having described how to behave in Takt og Tone, Hvordan Vi Omgås, from 1918?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2023 exam.

da.q: Hvem er kendt for at have beskrevet, hvordan man skal opføre sig i ’Takt og Tone – Hvordan Vi Omgås’ fra 1918?

learn.text: Emma Gad also thought that people, through clear rules, should be helped to be together without conflict. She is therefore first and foremost known for "Takt og Tone – Hvordan Vi Omgås", "Tact and Tone: How We Get Along", from 1918, which is the best-known Danish book about how one should behave.
